subject: MAP draft: POC connectivity & milestone owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@datawave.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@datawave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft: POC connectivity & milestone owners

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Great to meet you both today — appreciated the clear priorities. Attached is a first-pass MAP focused on the POC environment connectivity milestone (attachment: MAP-draft-DataWave-20270225.pdf). Below is a concise recap + proposed owners and a recommended target close for the POC (we can shift dates based on your bandwidth).

High-level next steps (POC connectivity milestone):
- VPC peering setup: DataWave infra to request VPC peering; Redwood to accept and verify. Owner: DataWave (action: open peering request by 3/1).
- IP allowlists: DataWave security to provide static egress IPs; Redwood will add to allowlist. Owner: DataWave Sec / Redwood SRE (action: list by 3/3).
- SSO / SAML: Config + test user accounts; Redwood will share SAML metadata and test instructions. Owner: Redwood (Karthik) to provide metadata by 2/28; DataWave to configure test user by 3/5.
- Secrets/KMS: Key wrapping or customer-managed key (CMK) decision. Owner: DataWave Security & Procurement (decision needed by 3/8).

Target POC ready date (connectivity complete): 2027-03-10 (tentative)
Target customer-facing demo: 2027-03-17

Dependencies & blockers we flagged today:
- Procurement sign-off on NDA/MSA (Procurement contact: procurement@datawave.com)
- Network change window (DataWave netops availability week starting 3/1)
- KMS policy review for bring-your-own-key (BYOK) option

Please see the attached MAP PDF for a simple milestone table (owner, due date, status). Karthik is copied to confirm the SAML/KMS tech notes; Marissa is looped for commercial alignment.

Request: Can you confirm owners for VPC peering and who will raise the peering ticket internally? Also confirm whether DataWave will use a CMK or accept Redwood-managed keys for the POC.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute kickoff if helpful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(650) 555-0142

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 16:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: POC connectivity & milestone owners

Thanks Ben — quick technical clarifications from my side so we can avoid back-and-forth during the network change window.

Notes / recommendations:
1) VPC peering specifics: Redwood needs the peer VPC ID, region, and a contact who can approve the peering request. We can perform the initial validation in our staging account once the peering is provisioned. Recommended action: DataWave to create the peering request and set the description to DW-Redwood-POC.

2) IP allowlists: If DataWave can provide a small CIDR (or static set of egress IPs) we will add them to the whitelist. If not, we can provision an outbound NAT with a stable egress address on Redwood’s side for the POC — slightly slower but works as a fallback. Owner: DataWave netops to confirm by 3/3; fallback option can be enabled by Redwood SRE by 3/6.

3) SSO/SAML: I will share metadata and a short test plan (SAML metadata file + test user steps). We support typical NameID formats; if you have a custom attribute mapping, flag that now so we can prepare.

4) Secrets/KMS: For the POC we recommend Redwood-managed keys unless there is an explicit compliance requirement for BYOK. If you choose BYOK, please share KMS ARN and IAM policy constraints so we can set up key access. Decision needed by 3/8 to avoid delays.

I’ve added two small follow-ups in the attached network sketch (dw-network-sketch.png) to show the peering/NAT options. If DataWave prefers, we can do a 30-min tech kickoff next week (I have availability Tue/Wed mornings PST).

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Thanks Ben and Karthik — helpful notes and the sketch is useful. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- VPC peering: I'll own raising the peering request with NetOps. I'll include the VPC ID, region, and a primary approver (Tom). I will create the ticket by end of day 3/1.
- IP allowlist: We can provide a set of static egress IPs but need to confirm the final list with NetOps (I'll confirm by 3/3).
- SSO/SAML: We prefer Okta and will map attributes on our side. Karthik — please send the metadata and the short test plan.
- Secrets/KMS: Procurement will evaluate CMK for production. For the POC, Procurement prefers Redwood-managed keys to keep it simple unless compliance forces BYOK. Procurement, can you confirm? Procurement, looped.

One ask: can Redwood provision a temporary test user role with limited access so our engineers can validate SAML and KMS workflows without provisioning real prod accounts?

We can plan the tech kickoff on Tue 3/2 10:00 AM PST if that works for Redwood. Also, procurement — I’ve attached the contacts; we’ll need the draft MSA for internal review.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Cloud Engineering, DataWave Analytics
aisha.khan@datawave.com
